dashboard.title: Release windows — Dashboard
dashboard.description: Tracking when films show up on Rakuten TV PL, based on daily JustWatch scans.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Add your first films on the Films tab to start tracking.

data.title: Data
data.description: Full scan history — one row per film per scan day.
data.emptyDescription: Run the first scan from the Dashboard to collect historical data.

films.title: Films
films.description: The films tracked in the release-window register — title, year and the foreign titles used to search JustWatch.
films.emptyDescription: Add the first film to start tracking daily availability on Rakuten TV PL.
films.deleteDescription: The scan history of this film is kept, but the film disappears from the tracked list.

log.title: Log
log.description: Scanner run history — when it ran, how many films, what changed, which errors.
log.cronIntro: This scan checks every tracked film for availability on Rakuten TV PL through the public JustWatch GraphQL API and writes one entry per day. To collect data for the whole project period (about 6 months), run it once a day from cron on a machine that can reach the deployed frontend instance:
log.localDev: Locally / dev: <cmd>npm run okna-czasowe:scan</cmd> (targets <url>http://localhost:3000</url> by default). The script calls the same endpoint as the “Scan now” button — <endpoint>POST /api/okna-czasowe/scan</endpoint>.
log.emptyDescription: The log fills up after the first scan — manual or from cron.

form.noForeignTitles: No extra titles — the search will use the main title only.
form.foreignTitlePlaceholder: e.g. the original title or one in another language
